properties.name: app.jwt.roles-claim
properties.description: Name of the claim that carries the comma-separated roles list.

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-256 secret (minimum 32 characters / 256 bits). Must be provided via environment variable in non-dev environments.

properties.name: calculator.category-bonus.bonuses
properties.description: Map of category name → bonus percentage. Keys must match {@link com.bank.calculator.model.enums.CustomerCategory} names.

properties.name: calculator.category-bonus.max-total-bonus
properties.description: Maximum combined category bonus that can be applied. Default 2.00 %.
